## Method {#sec-method}

We timed the rise of twelve loaves. The rate follows $r = r_0 \cdot 2^{\Delta T/10}$.

| Temperature | Hours |
|-------------|-------|
| 20 °C       | 6     |
| 30 °C       | 3     |

: Proofing time by temperature {#tbl-times}

## Results

@tbl-times shows that warmer dough rises faster, as @sec-method predicts.
